description_excerpt: Job Requirements As the Finance Manager for Brooks, you will be a member of our high-performing Finance Team. Utilizing your financial analysis expertise, knowledge of technical accounting, tax, the regulatory environment, and local compliance requirements, as well as your strong relationship-building abilities, you will contribute to the company’s success and growth through the management and optimization of accounting operations, the financial close process, and financial reporting. The Finance Manager will continuously seek opportunities to improve finance and accounting operations…
